latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — lets you trim and export video clips via PC with easy text instructions.

- Upload video clips and describe your edits; AI cloud backend handles trimming and export (default: 1080p MP4)
- No timeline or export settings needed — just type what to trim or cut
- Automatic cloud setup with free credits on first use; no install required
- Status, credits, and balance queries supported
- Handles common video, audio, and image formats up to 500MB
- Fast processing: typical short clips ready to download in 20–40 seconds
